messages:
Maya Chen: @northbridge-support thanks for raising this — I pulled their request IDs and see p99 jump ~2.8s starting 14:12 UTC. is that what you observed?
northbridge-support: yep that matches. our users hit timeouts in search UI 14:10-14:15. embeddings endpoint is blocking the UI.
Maya Chen: curious — are these interactive single calls or batched jobs? any unusual headers or SDK versions?
northbridge-support: single interactive calls, small payloads (~30 tokens) but highly bursty from a handful of app servers.
Rohan Patel: trace summary: a small subset of tenant sessions creates concurrent spikes -> queue growth on their shard. p95 okay; p99 shows long queue wait + kv cache miss pattern. backend cpu is fine but the queue is the culprit.
Jules Rivera: sounds like a noisy-tenant case on shared embed pools. quick mitigations: (A) soft per-tenant concurrency cap with queued throttling (B) create a short-lived reservation for their peak. Which do we want as customer-visible fast fix?
Maya Chen: customer prefers minimal visible change. temporary bypass/buffer that avoids hard 429s would be ideal while we stand up reservation.
Rohan Patel: suggested config: allow burst up to 8 concur, then queue with token-bucket draining at 5 r/s, only 429 if queue > 60s. and issue a scoped bypass token (2k req/min) for 20m to stabilize their UI while reservation is provisioned.
Jules Rivera: I'll craft the routing policy. sample config to push:
```
policy: tenant:northbridge
concurrency_limit: 8
burst_window_ms: 2000
queue_timeout_s: 60
throttle_mode: queued
drain_rps: 5
bypass_token_ttl_s: 1200
```
Rohan Patel: important: bypass token must be audited and scoped to tenant+route. also add a short alert for tenant_p99>2s to avoid surprises.
Maya Chen: northbridge — ok to accept a bypass token emailed to your SRE contact? we'll ask you to rotate it after handoff.
northbridge-support: yes, send to our SRE and we'll rotate after 24h. prefer no visible 429s.
Maya Chen: action items: 1) Jules push smoothing policy -> canary deploy 2) Rohan create audited bypass token tag=nb-bypass-2023 3) Maya send steps to customer and request small HAR + sample request ids for repro.
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-policy-service v2.14.1 -> canary nodes (2/3)
Jules Rivera: policy pushed to canary. DO NOT paste token into public channels. example curl (redacted):
```
# Header: X-Bypass-Token: <token>
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redwood_key>" -H "X-Bypass-Token: nb-temp-XXXX" \
  -d '{"input":"example"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Rohan Patel: created token nb-temp-9a4f, audit=nb-bypass-2023, scope=tenant:northbridge, ttl=1200s. alert added: tenant_p99>2s for 3m -> page.
Maya Chen: sending token and test instructions to customer. northbridge — can you run a quick 10-session canary and report back in 15m?
northbridge-support: running on staging 14:28 UTC.
northbridge-support: staging looks good; p99 down to ~600ms on sample traffic, no 429s.
Rohan Patel: recommend keeping bypass active for 30m while Jules finishes reservation. I'll also spin up a repro harness replaying their burst to validate kv cache behavior.
Jules Rivera: requesting a small reservation slot on the embed pool for 30m; if approved we'll shift their traffic to reserved pool with no throttles. kickoff now.
deploy-bot: canary deploy finished: routing-policy-service v2.14.1 -> success on nodes (3/3)
Maya Chen: thanks. follow-ups: Rohan -> repro harness and request id list, Jules -> reservation ticket + commit id, Maya -> confirm token rotation with customer. I'll draft a short incident note after 24h stable.
Rohan Patel: redacted log excerpt from problematic trace:
```
[14:12:02] tenant=northbridge req=MXa9z queue_wait_ms=2987 kv_cache_miss=true backend_lat_ms=120
[14:12:03] tenant=northbridge req=MXa9z serv_time_ms=3050 status=200
```
Maya Chen: long-term we should add automated detection that applies smoothing when per-tenant concurrency spikes >5x baseline and also encourage reservations for sustained spikes.
Jules Rivera: creating eng-platform ticket for auto-smoothing, owner=eng-platform.
northbridge-support: appreciate the quick turnaround — keep us posted when reservation is live and we'll rotate the token. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: keeping thread open for 24h monitoring. closing summary: incident_type=tenant_tail_latency; immediate_fix=queued throttling + bypass token; midterm=reservation + auto-smoothing; owners=Maya, Rohan, Jules.
